name: scaling-run-gate
description: The compiler scaling gate's per-shape runner run-gate.mjs and its Jet twin run-gate/run.jet over the jet_scaling_gate and jet_scaling_reports packages, #5072 c7. Each run gates one or two stress shapes (ladder 2,4,8 plus the N=1 baseline) in counter-only mode with fake.sh as the `command:` compiler, one receipt and report.md per shape under work/run-<shape> and the whole run's report.md in work: linear work passes; quadratic work fails its growth; a counter that is zero below the top rung appears (the report prints its in-memory ratio as inf); a compiler failing from N=4 is a compile failure and an incomplete ladder; an unknown placeholder is a run error (exit 2). The check prints stdout with the case directory as <case> (progress lines up to their timings, sorted) and every report.md with the receipts' start and finish times as <time>. The other cases cover --help and invalid invocations (exit 2, the message on stderr). Timing mode is not a case: its verdicts depend on the machine's speed.
